office_does: The Prosecuting Attorney is King County's lawyer and prosecutes misdemeanor and felony criminal cases.
race_blurb: Incumbent Leesa Manion, first elected in 2022, is unopposed.

candidates.summary: Incumbent King County Prosecuting Attorney, first elected in 2022 after 15 years as the office's Chief of Staff; the first woman and first person of color elected to the office.
highlights: Pamphlet priorities: neighborhood safety, property crime, survivors of domestic violence and sexual assault, and alternative sentencing for veterans, youth and people with behavioral health and addiction challenges [S1]
Created Gender-Based Violence and Prevention and Economic Crimes & Wage Theft divisions; co-founded the Choose 180 juvenile diversion program [S2]
Endorsed by former Governors Locke and Gregoire, Executive Girmay Zahilay and the Alliance for Gun Responsibility, among others [S1]
